name: context-braid-raycast
title: ContextBraid
description: Auto-pair your local Git repos, editor windows, and AI browser tabs.
author: elcoosp

commands.name: index
commands.title: Open Project Cockpit
commands.description: View and jump to your braided repos and AI agents

commands.name: cycle-project
commands.title: Cycle Active Project Windows
commands.description: Rotate between Zed and AI tabs for the active repository

commands.name: jump-alert
commands.title: Jump to Next Agent Alert
commands.description: Focus the next AI tab waiting on a captcha or finished archive

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Workspace Status Menu
commands.subtitle: ContextBraid
commands.description: Live macOS menu bar indicator for active repositories and AI coding agents

preferences.name: notifyWhenFocused
preferences.title: Notify When Tab Is Focused
preferences.label: Send macOS notification banners even when the AI tab is active in the frontmost window
preferences.description: When disabled (default), notifications only fire for background tabs, side-by-side windows, or when another app is active.

preferences.name: autoDownloadZip
preferences.title: Auto-Download ZIP Artifacts
preferences.label: Automatically download newly generated .zip files from AI agent tabs
preferences.description: Synced live with the local ContextBraid daemon and browser extension.

preferences.name: favoriteEditor
preferences.title: Favorite Code Editor
preferences.description: Default editor used when opening repositories from the cockpit.

preferences.name: muteDurationMinutes
preferences.title: Default Alert Mute Duration
preferences.description: Duration used when muting repository notifications (Cmd+M).
